_meta.description: Real Fireflies API is a single GraphQL endpoint (POST https://api.fireflies.ai/graphql), NOT REST paths. The request is {query, variables} with a `transcripts(limit, skip, fromDate)` query; the response nests results under data.transcripts. The pre-fix client (cloned from Brex) issued REST GET /transcripts, which a real install 404s. Doc-derived; ids/emails are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://docs.fireflies.ai/graphql-api/query/transcripts (POST /graphql, transcripts(limit,skip,fromDate) query; response data.transcripts[]; rate limit surfaces as 200 with errors[].extensions.code=too_many_requests)

body.query: query Transcripts($limit: Int, $skip: Int, $fromDate: DateTime) { transcripts(limit: $limit, skip: $skip, fromDate: $fromDate) { id title date duration organizer_email participants transcript_url } }
